column2: [intro]
Bad taste is what captivates us,
Beyond norms and predetermined lines,
It’s so tied to our times and to fashion’s fuss,
That the grotesque can become trendy, without signs.
Let’s be charmed by this ugliness,
For in extravagance, there’s happiness,
Bad taste is what sets us apart,
For the unusual is what surpasses the art.
Let’s dare bold colors, shocking patterns too,
In bad taste, let’s find our delight anew,
Each creation, though offbeat and strange,
Holds within an unexpected beauty, ready to change.
Let’s be charmed by this ugliness,
For in extravagance, there’s happiness,
Bad taste is what sets us apart,
For the unusual is what surpasses the art.
